practicals.title: Biostatistics
content: Definition, application, sample size, the importance of sample size
factors influencing sample size, dropouts, statistical tests of
significance, type of significance tests, parametric tests (students “t”
test, ANOVA, Correlation coefficient, regression), non-parametric
tests (Wilcoxon rank tests, analysis of variance, correlation, chi
square test), null hypothesis, P values, degree of freedom

practicals.title: Medical research
content: History, values in medical ethics, autonomy, beneficence, non
maleficence, double effect, conflicts between autonomy and
confidentiality, criticisms of orthodox medical ethics, the
importance of communication, control resolution, guidelines, ethics
committees, cultural concerns, truth-telling, online business
practices, conflicts of interest, referral, vendor relationships
treatment of family members, sexual relationships, fatality
